name: Light Studio
tagline: Simulate a tower's lighting and electrical load floor by floor, live.
description: Simulates a tower's lighting design and electrical load by floor and operating scene, with a night render showing live total and per-floor power draw in kW, drawn from a fixture library and photometric summary, and a design-analysis / pre-compliance (LPD) report.

page.objective: See a tower's real lighting load, floor by floor, before it's specified rather than after.
page.problem: Lighting and electrical load are normally estimated per floor separately, without a live view of how they add up across the whole tower.
page.solution: A tower model and operating scene drive a live night render with a real-time kW readout per floor, feeding directly into a pre-compliance report.

highlights.headline: A live night render of a tower with real-time per-floor power draw.
points: Runs solar path analysis on the 3D building model alongside a fixture-library photometric summary.
Night render updates a live total-power readout with a per-floor kW breakdown as scenes change.
Produces a Design Analysis / Pre-Compliance report from the same model.
